source_identity.primary_source: R. J. Donnelly and C. F. Barenghi, The Observed Properties of Liquid Helium at the Saturated Vapor Pressure, J. Phys. Chem. Ref. Data 27, 1217-1274 (1998)
source_identity.section_locator: Section 2, adopted superfluid-density database and comments; Section 1, density fit
source_identity.permission_or_terms: Public reference-data evaluation used for internal research calibration; remote source is not redistributed.

uncertainty_source.superfluid_density_locator: Section 2 adopted database: Maynard, 1.2-2.15 K, uncertainty <0.5%; Tam and Ahlers, 1.553-2.15917 K, uncertainty <0.5%
uncertainty_source.total_density_locator: Section 1 density representation: mean fractional deviation from the fit is 0.5e-6
uncertainty_source.interpretation: Conservative upper bounds, not one-standard-deviation estimates; covariance is unavailable, so absolute contributions are added rather than combined as independent statistical errors.
uncertainty_source.excluded_uncertainty: Absolute ITS-90 temperature-scale uncertainty is not supplied by this package; the result is conditional on the recommended source temperature grid.

calibration_design.preprocessing: Central difference on preregistered 1.6, 1.7, and 1.8 K source rows; no regression selection, TTG data, Xie 2026 access, or threshold tuning.

independence_statement: The calibration uses equilibrium He-4 reference properties only. It does not use Ding graphite, Xie 2026, any TTG target curve, Landauer, or a transport coefficient.
claim_boundary: The package calibrates one local He-4 response coordinate and its action-field orientation. It is lane-specific, conditional on the source temperature grid, and does not identify Phi universally with superfluid density or close the SI energy-density and transport maps.
